ValidationRule.description: Set CFIN & Billing Information is required for Bill To Account Groups
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias<> "sconn",
NOT(OR($RecordType.Name = "SAP Noblelight", $RecordType.Name = "S4 - Boulder", $RecordType.Name = "SAP Asia", $RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal")),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Bill To - H004"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Bill To - 0001"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Payer/Bill-to Entry - 0003"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Bill To - W004"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "QioDebitoren Europäische Union - DEEU"), $RecordType.Name = "Ax Billerica" ),
OR( ISBLANK(Person_Name__c), ISBLANK(EMAIL_ADDRESS__c), Set_CFIN_Defaults__c = FALSE ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Set CFIN Defaults and Fill all Billing Fields
